title: Nova Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Press Release: Nova Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results. Read More!

**Nova Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results**


REHOVOT, Israel


, Nov. 5, 2026


/PRNewswire/ — Nova (NASDAQ: NVMI) today announced financial results for the third quarter, the three-month period ended September 30, 2026.


**Third Quarter 2026 Highlights:**


- Record quarterly revenue of $287.8 million, 13% increase QoQ, and up 28% YoY.
- Record GAAP net income of $90.0 million, or $2.64 per diluted share, 20% increase QoQ, and up 39% YoY.
- Record non-GAAP net income of $98.4 million, or $2.86 per diluted share, 14% increase QoQ, and up 32% YoY.
- Record revenue from Advanced Packaging solutions, driven by capacity expansions in HBM and advanced logic
- Record revenue from memory devices, driven by demand for dimensional and materials metrology solutions

**Management Comments**


“We delivered an exceptional third quarter, achieving record revenue and profitability while broadening our position across the semiconductor industry’s most important growth areas,” said Gaby Waisman, President and CEO. “Record revenue in memory and advanced packaging, together with strong demand from logic customers, reflects both the strength of the current investment cycle and the growing adoption of Nova’s solutions in critical applications. Supported by enhanced visibility into customer investment plans, we remain confident in our ability to capture opportunities created by the industry’s most advanced technology transitions.”


**2026** **F** **ourth** **Quarter Financial Outlook**


Management provided an outlook for the fourth quarter, the period ending December 31, 2026. Based on current estimates, management expects:


- $305 million to $315 million in revenue
- $2.78 to $2.93 in diluted GAAP EPS
- $3.03 to $3.18 in diluted non-GAAP EPS


**2026 Third Quarter Results**


Total revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were $287.8 million, an increase of 13% compared with the second quarter of 2026 and an increase of 28% compared with the third quarter of 2025.


Gross margin in the third quarter of 2026 was 57.7%, compared with 56.5% in the second quarter of 2026 and 56.7% in the third quarter of 2025.


Operating expenses in the third quarter of 2026 were $73.3 million, compared with $68.0 million in the second quarter of 2026 and $63.6 million in the third quarter of 2025.


On a GAAP basis, the Company reported net income of $90.0 million, or $2.64 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2026. This is compared with net income of $75.0 million, or $2.20 per diluted share, in the second quarter of 2026, and $61.4 million, or $1.90 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025.


On a non-GAAP basis, the Company reported net income of $98.4 million, or $2.86 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2026. This is compared with net income of $86.5 million, or $2.51 per diluted share, in the second quarter of 2026, and $70.0 million, or $2.16 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025.

**About Nova**


Nova is a leading innovator and key provider of material, optical and chemical metrology solutions for advanced process control in semiconductor manufacturing. Nova delivers continuous innovation by providing state-of-the-art, high-performance metrology solutions for effective process control throughout the semiconductor fabrication lifecycle. Nova’s product portfolio, which combines high-precision hardware and cutting-edge software, provides its customers with deep insight into developing and producing the most advanced semiconductor devices. Nova’s unique capability to deliver innovative solutions enables its customers to improve performance, enhance product yields and accelerate time to market. Nova acts as a partner to semiconductor manufacturers from its offices worldwide. Additional information may be found on[Nova’s website link](https://www.novami.com/) –[https://www.novami.com/](https://www.novami.com/) .


Nova is traded on the NASDAQ and TASE, NASDAQ ticker symbol NVMI.


**Use of Non-GAAP Adjusted Financial Measures**


This press release provides financial measures that exclude amortization of acquired intangible assets, inventory step-up, stock-based compensation expenses, acquisition related expenses, revaluation of operating lease liabilities and remeasurement of intercompany loans, amortization of debt issuance costs, discrete tax reserve release, net and tax effect of non-GAAP adjustment, as applicable, and are therefore not calculated in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP). Management believes that these non-GAAP financial measures provide meaningful supplemental information regarding Nova’s performance because they reflect our operational results and enhance management’s and investors’ ability to evaluate Nova’s performance before charges or benefits considered by management to be outside Nova’s ongoing operating results. The presentation of this non-GAAP financial information is not intended to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for the financial information prepared and presented in accordance with GAAP. Management believes that it is in the best interest of its investors to provide financial information that will facilitate comparison of both historical and future results and allow greater transparency to supplemental information used by management in its financial and operational decision making. A reconciliation of each GAAP to non-GAAP financial measure discussed in this press release is contained in the accompanying financial tables.
